actor.name: UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees (UNRWA)

relations_to.summary: Defend UNRWA and the refugee file: the PA wants the agency kept as the refugee framework and the technocratic committee reportedly wanted to work with it, while Israel (Kalandia raid and seizure, Aug 2026; HQ demolition, Jan 2026) and the Board of Peace ('UNRWA's days are over', 25 Sep 2026) push it out; the EU says it will cooperate with UNRWA.

sources.title: Hamas slams Board of Peace for refusal to work with UNRWA in Gaza
Israel extends campaign against UNRWA to advance West Bank annexation
EU convenes 1st Palestine Donor Group meeting, vows support for stronger Palestinian governance

relations_to.summary: Israeli measures against UNRWA in East Jerusalem: demolition of its headquarters (Jan 2026) and the raid and seizure of the Kalandia training centre led by Ben-Gvir (25 Aug 2026) under the Oct 2024 ban law; the UN deputy coordinator says UN premises are inviolable. The US cut about USD 360m (30% of the budget), per UNRWA's adviser.
